audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer attributes Mel's kit to the wrong slots throughout: it calls the root her Q, calls a damage zone her W, and calls the projectile reflect her ultimate.
audit.why: Riot kit data: Q Radiant Volley is the 950-range zone; W Rebuttal is the self barrier that reflects projectiles (38/35/33/29/26s); E Solar Snare is the 1000-range root/slow; R Golden Eclipse is a global Overwhelm-stack strike. Riven's R Wind Slash carries the projectile flag, so Rebuttal (W) is what blanks it - not her ultimate. This is the decisive interaction of the matchup and the mirror audit (mel__riven) reached the same conclusion.
audit.corrected: Name Radiant Volley (Q), Rebuttal (W), Solar Snare (E), Golden Eclipse (R) and Searing Brilliance (P) correctly, and state that Rebuttal reflects Wind Slash.

audit.why: Difficulty 7.5/10 TRICKY is consistent with 54.73% over 1184 games: Riven wins on paper but the lane is range-gated early and punished hard by a landed Solar Snare.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 spike text credits Mel's ultimate with the reflect, so the reader plans their whole R usage around the wrong cooldown.
audit.why: Golden Eclipse (R) is 120/100/80s global damage; Rebuttal (W) is the 38/35/33/29/26s reflect. Baiting the wrong ability means firing Wind Slash into a live barrier.
audit.corrected: Level 6 spike keyed to Rebuttal's 26-38s window, not her ult.

audit.whatIsWrong: Searing Brilliance (P) is never mentioned anywhere in the matchup.
audit.why: Mel's passive loads her next basic attack with up to nine bonus projectiles after any ability cast, so the auto wind-up - not the spell cast - is the burst tell.
audit.corrected: Added the auto-attack tell to the Key Ability Interactions block.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers anywhere in the content layer.
audit.why: Solar Snare is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s and Rebuttal is 38/35/33/29/26s - concrete windows the player can count.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns written into the early/mid prose and the Level 6 spike.

edits.before: Mel's ranged Q poke reaches you before your W is online and her W zone punishes any aggressive step — farm at Q-tip range and do not burn E into a Level 1 she cannot kill you back.
edits.after: Radiant Volley (Q) reaches 950 units before Ki Burst is online and Solar Snare (E) roots any aggressive step — farm at Q-tip range and do not burn E into a Level 1 she cannot kill you in.

edits.before: Her Q root plus W zone gives complete lane control at Level 2 before you have the combo to punish it — she can deny your pattern freely from range.
edits.after: Solar Snare (E) roots and Radiant Volley (Q) zones the wave at Level 2, before you own the combo to punish it — she denies your pattern freely from 1000 range.

edits.before: Even with full kit her Q root stops your Q-chain mid-animation and her W zone adds up fast — you need her Q on cooldown before you can safely commit E-W-Q.
edits.after: Even with full kit Solar Snare roots you out of the Broken Wings chain and Radiant Volley chips fast — you need her E down for its 9-11s before you commit E-W-Q3.

edits.before: She maintains range control through Levels 4-5, denying your wave pattern with Q poke and W zone — the gap between her abilities and your commit tools keeps you from converting trades into kills.
edits.after: She holds range control through Levels 4-5 with Radiant Volley poke and Solar Snare, and Rebuttal (W) blanks what you do land — the gap between her 1000 range and your 250-unit dashes stops trades becoming kills.

edits.before: Her reflect ultimate removes the Wind Slash kill threat she feared all laning phase, and your execute range spike partially offsets her burst — both need to play carefully around the other's key ability.
edits.after: Rebuttal (W) reflects Wind Slash straight back at you, and Golden Eclipse (R) reaches you anywhere on the map off stacked Overwhelm — Blade of the Exile is still your spike, but spend it only in the 26-38s her W is down.

edits.before: Mel's zone and reflect pressure is highest at first-item timing when she can burst through your shield and reflect your execute — never fire Wind Slash at a reflect-ready Mel.
edits.after: Mel's poke pressure peaks at first-item timing, when Radiant Volley eats your E shield and Rebuttal turns the execute around — never fire Wind Slash at a Mel still holding W.

edits.before: Mel's reflect ultimate (R) can send your Wind Slash back at you — never fire Wind Slash into a full-HP Mel who has her R ready.
edits.after: Rebuttal (W), not her ultimate, reflects Wind Slash back at you — bait the barrier with an E dash and fire in the 26-38s it is down.

edits.before: With two completed items Mel's reflect loses value against your sustained melee pressure — she cannot kite an Immortal Shieldbow + Black Cleaver Riven in a side lane.
edits.after: With two completed items Rebuttal blocks one rotation and no more against your sustained pressure — she cannot kite an Immortal Shieldbow + Black Cleaver Riven in a side lane.

edits.before: At Level 1 Mel's ranged Q poke punishes every approach before your W is online, so farm with the tip of your Q chain and accept chip — burning E just to close range at Level 1 is exactly the trade she wants. At Level 2 she gains full lane control: her Q can root you, her W zone denies the wave, and she has no reason to step forward, so play for farm and watch which direction she positions her Q. Level 3 gives you your full kit but she still dictates range — your window is the instant her Q is on cooldown: E in, W stun before she can zone you out, Q chain to knockup, then Q3 into her body and back out before her zone damage adds up.
edits.after: At Level 1 Radiant Volley (Q) punishes every approach before Ki Burst is online, so farm with the tip of Broken Wings and accept chip — burning E just to close range at Level 1 is exactly the trade she wants. At Level 2 she takes full lane control: Solar Snare (E) roots from 1000 units, Radiant Volley denies the wave, and she has no reason to step forward, so farm and watch where she aims it. Level 3 gives you your full kit but she still dictates range — your window is the moment Solar Snare is down: E in, W stun before she repositions, Broken Wings to the knockup, then Q3 through her and back out before Radiant Volley ticks.

edits.before: Levels 4 through 5 are her strongest sustained lane window: she denies you the wave freely with Q poke and W zone, and without the Level 6 execute you cannot reliably close out a kill even when you land the full combo. Play the cooldown game — track her Q root timer and only engage when it is fully down, because a Q-rooted Riven in the middle of Mel's W zone is a dead Riven. At Level 6, resist the instinct to immediately press R and fire Wind Slash — her reflect (R) sends your own execute back at you at full damage. Force her to burn her reflect on your E shield dash or a non-lethal trade first, then follow up with Wind Slash when she is reflect-less and below half HP.
edits.after: Levels 4 through 5 are her strongest sustained lane window: she denies you the wave with Radiant Volley (Q) and Solar Snare (E), and without the Level 6 execute you cannot close out a kill even when the full combo lands. Play the cooldown game — Solar Snare is down 9-11 seconds and that is your only safe entry, because a rooted Riven standing inside Radiant Volley is a dead Riven. At Level 6, resist the instinct to press R and fire Wind Slash — Wind Slash is a projectile and Rebuttal (W) reflects it back at you at full damage. Bait Rebuttal out with an E shield dash or a non-lethal trade, then fire Wind Slash in the 26-38 seconds it stays down.

edits.before: Once you hit Immortal Shieldbow and a second item Mel's ability to kill you in lane collapses — the shield absorbs her burst rotation and she cannot kite you effectively in a closed side-lane or brush. Avoid open-field chases where she can walk backward and poke; instead crash a wave, step into brush, and force the short-range engagement she cannot win. In team fights, never lead with Wind Slash into a full-HP Mel — her reflect turns your execute into a near-instakill on yourself. Peel her reflect with your E shield absorption first, then commit the Wind Slash on the follow-up.
edits.after: Once you hit Immortal Shieldbow and a second item Mel's ability to kill you in lane collapses — the shield absorbs her burst rotation and she cannot kite you effectively in a closed side-lane or brush. Avoid open-field chases where she can walk backward and poke; instead crash a wave, step into brush, and force the short-range engagement she cannot win. In team fights, never open with Wind Slash into a Mel still holding Rebuttal (W) — the barrier reflects the projectile straight back and blanks your ultimate. Bait it with Broken Wings, then commit Wind Slash on the follow-up.

edits.before: Bait Mel's W zone and R reflect BEFORE committing your Wind Slash or full combo so they land on an enemy with no answers
edits.after: Bait Solar Snare (E) and Rebuttal (W) BEFORE committing Wind Slash or the full combo so they land on a Mel with no answer left

edits.before: Stack Q-auto weaves on Mel when her W zone is off cooldown and she has no reflect stored to turn your burst around
edits.after: Stack Q-auto weaves on Mel while Solar Snare is on cooldown and Rebuttal is spent, so nothing turns your burst around

edits.before: Land her Q root to lock you in place and layer her W zone damage on top while you are stuck
edits.after: Land Solar Snare (E) to lock you in place and layer Radiant Volley ticks on top while you are stuck

edits.before: Hold R to reflect your Wind Slash or a dive-and-execute combo and punish reckless all-ins
edits.after: Hold Rebuttal (W) to reflect your Wind Slash, then punish the failed all-in with Golden Eclipse

edits.before: Track Mel's Solar Snare: Her root / slow zone — sets up her combo. Dodge it. When it is down — Q3-knockup + W-stun burst.
edits.after: Track Solar Snare (E): the root sets up her combo — dodge it, then Q3-knockup + W-stun. Searing Brilliance (P) loads her next auto.

notes: Systemic slot mix-up in riven vs mel content: the reflect was credited to Mel's ultimate (it is Rebuttal, W) and the root to her Q (it is Solar Snare, E). Riven's Wind Slash carries the projectile flag, so Rebuttal reflects it - the matchup's decisive interaction, now stated, matching the mel__riven mirror audit. Level chart NOT changed: the packet's chart (Skill/Mel/Mel/Mel/Skill/Mel/Riven) is stale, the on-disk chart already gives Riven 4/7 and the full and content layers already agree row-for-row, so the flagged defect is already fixed on disk. Full layer refers to Mel as 'he' in tldr, winCon, tradeBad, ahead and several breakdown.* fields - Mel is female.
